title: Contract redline decision matrix, review SLA & routing workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable decision matrix and automated routing workflow for enterprise contract redlines (MSA/DPA), defining SLA targets for legal review, product signoff, and commercial approval. Deliverables: decision matrix by clause (liability, indemnity, data residency, security obligations), routing rules, automated JIRA/Linear integrations to surface high-risk redlines to Legal Counsel, and a public-facing internal playbook for Sales/AMs.
acceptance_criteria: Decision matrix created covering top 30 redline clauses with explicit risk tiers (Low/Medium/High)
Workflow implemented in Linear to auto-route redlines to Legal when risk tier = High
SLA targets documented: initial review <= 2 business days (High), <= 5 business days (Medium), <= 10 business days (Low)
Playbook published in Confluence with example email templates and escalation steps
Integrations verified with Sales quoting system to block signature if critical security clauses are redlined
activity: 2026-01-15 - Aisha created ticket after a cross-functional working session with Sales, Legal, and Customer Success; initial scope agreed.
2026-01-22 - Kickoff meeting: identified 3 primary pain points: inconsistent routing, no risk triage, lack of SLA visibility for Sales.
2026-01-30 - Collected 42 redline examples from last 12 months (AMs & Legal). Categorized clauses into products: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private.
2026-02-07 - Drafted clause-level decision matrix prototype (liability, indemnity, data processing, security, export controls). Shared with Legal for feedback.
2026-02-14 - Legal (Claire Huang) requested to escalate indemnity variations over $2M to Senior Counsel; added as High-risk rule.
2026-02-21 - Engineering (ENG-4125) scoped required metadata fields for redline submissions to enable routing: clause_type, proposed_text, customer_risk_flag, revenue_bucket.
2026-02-28 - Product: defined SLA targets and monitoring KPIs; created tracking dashboard spec for Console (latency: mean review time by risk tier).
2026-03-03 - PM review: updated matrix to treat DPA data residency requests as Medium by default, escalated to High if combined with encrypted key custody requests.
2026-03-08 - Compliance reviewed privacy-related rules; added KMS/HSM, SOC2/ISO references to playbook examples.
2026-03-10 - Implemented Linear automations: label assignment, assignee suggestion (Legal Counsel), and SLA due date calculation. Running pilot with two AE teams.
Pending - Collect pilot feedback, refine matrix thresholds, and finalize playbook for company-wide rollout.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales bypasses workflow by sending separate redlines; Mitigation: embed acceptance checklist in quoting UI and require Linear ticket ID for signature
Risk: SLA targets not met due to Legal capacity; Mitigation: define fallback reviewers and enable Sales Ops triage for low-risk items
Risk: Overly conservative matrix blocks deals; Mitigation: include negotiation playbook and pre-approved concessions for common deviations
implementation_notes: Use existing Linear webhooks to create contract redline tickets from the quoting tool (ENG-4125).
Expose a triage form in the Sales portal with structured fields to reduce review noise (clause_type, clause_text, ask, customer_justification, revenue_impact).
Flag any clause tagged 'indemnity' or 'liability' with a revenue_bucket >= 500k as High risk automatically.
Include link to canonical MSA/DPA template versions in every redline ticket to reduce context switching.
notes_for_sales: When a customer requests a material change to indemnity or liability, do not sign until Legal has closed the ticket and set an exception in the CRM.
If the redline includes encryption key custody changes (bring-your-own-key), inform Compliance and set risk tier to High.
Use the provided negotiation concessions table in the playbook to speed approvals for Medium/Low risk asks.
next_steps: Complete 3-week pilot with AE teams (Pilot cohort A/B), gather quantitative SLA metrics.
Refine matrix thresholds based on pilot: aim for <10% false positives for High-risk classification.
Deliver final playbook and run training sessions for Sales and AMs (target date 2026-04-02).
